items.hed: Texans play the winless Chargers Sunday at SoFi
items.insight: The club's Friday preview says the Chargers are 0-7, have scored 71 points in the five games after opening losses to the Cardinals and Raiders, and have gone 27 consecutive drives without a touchdown. The same note says Houston has scored 17 touchdowns this season to Los Angeles's nine, and that Justin Herbert has thrown five touchdowns and 10 interceptions. Safety Derwin James Jr. went on injured reserve last week. Sunday, Nov. 8, is at SoFi Stadium.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Ed Schipul, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.

items.hed: Astros GM Randy Flores is interviewing Albert Pujols and Morgan Ensberg for manager
items.insight: MLB.com reported Wednesday that Flores, hired Friday as the club's 15th general manager, will interview former teammates Albert Pujols and Morgan Ensberg for the opening left by Joe Espada. A source told MLB.com that Pujols was scheduled to arrive in Houston late Wednesday and interview Thursday at Daikin Park. The club has not confirmed the interviews. MLB.com also reports the Astros will interview Rangers bench coach Luis Urueta, and that former Astros catcher Brad Ausmus discussed the manager role when he interviewed for the general manager job that went to Flores.

items.hed: Rockets visit the Suns Saturday night
items.insight: The league schedule lists Houston at Phoenix on Saturday, Nov. 7, at 9:00 p.m. Eastern. Wednesday's game at Toyota Center is already final on the same schedule. The next home date against Phoenix on the public ticket list is Nov. 25 at Toyota Center.
